name: OpenNutriView
summary: Stomach and FoodItem tooltips to help you eat the best food for a balanced and nutritious stomach content.
description:
This tool wil help you balance the nutrients in your stomach (the first 3 options), as well as suggesting the best food to eat based on your tastes for when your nutrient balance is good. Don't be scared to eat food from the second list when your food balance is good, sure you'll have a negative xp hit from eating that food, but once your stomach balances out again you'll have a better nutrient (and possibly tastiness) modifier.

 

The mod also has some configurations you can set by typing /onv config in chat:

Max Distance: Use this option to indicate that you do not wish to travel more that the specified distance to buy food from a shop.

Max Cost: Use this option to set the maximum amount you want to pay per 1000 calories. i.e. with `/onv setmaxcost 9` a Fern Campfire Salad with a price of 9 will not be suggested (9 / 900 * 1000 = 10), but a Jungle Campfire Stew with a price of 9.5 will be suggested (9.5 / 1100 * 1000 = 8.64)

Minimum Nutrients: Use this option to restrict showing options that have a nutrient value lower than the number you specify.

Ignored Currencies: Add currencies to this list if you do not want to show food being sold by shops using these currencies
